dogecoin.text: @fightfortheftr If you guys are going to keep presenting this as a fight to protect "alternatives to big tech", you should probably avoid referencing delusional pump and dump cults like dogecoin which represent some of the worst and most damaging aspects of crypto.

@CasPiancey We can't be too far from the point where a crypto cultist shows up threatening to blow something up unless the target adopts Bitcoin/Dogecoin/Cumrocket as an official currency and swears off of the US dollar.

Chances are the QAnon cultist bomber today was also a crypto cultist.
